title: Image LoRA training is not LLM fine-tuning
text:
Symptom / ask: Operator treats diffusion LoRA training like chat/LLM fine-tunes.
Cause: Same word 'training' covers different pipelines and success signals.
Do: For image/edit LoRAs, treat matched visual pairs (or captioned stills) as the main signal; captions steer but do not replace pairs.
Don't: Expect LLM dataset formats, chat transcripts, or text-only SFT recipes to train a visual LoRA.
Pointer: SDXL/FLUX/Kontext/Kohya desktop trainers.

title: Matched training pair hygiene
text:
Symptom / ask: LoRA drifts identity, pose, or framing.
Cause: Broken/fixed (or input/target) pairs do not show the same subject/framing, or only one side exists.
Do: Require same character/pose/clothes/rough framing; shared basename; reject mismatches; prefer diverse angles over near-duplicates.
Don't: Train on unpaired, wildly different crops, or stretched-to-fit pairs.
Pointer: any paired image-edit or character LoRA dataset.

title: Letterbox or cover-crop; never stretch
text:
Symptom / ask: Faces/bodies look squashy or spatial correspondence breaks in train/infer.
Cause: Width/height forced by stretch/squash instead of preserving aspect.
Do: Letterbox into model size for inference when needed; for paired training prefer cover-resize/center-crop with matched aspect — never anisotropic stretch.
Don't: Stretch pixels to fill a bucket; pads that break broken/fixed alignment are also harmful for paired train.
Pointer: Diffusers/SDXL/FLUX preprocessing.

title: VAE tiling can bake mesh artifacts
text:
Symptom / ask: Diamond/scale mesh on skin after enabling VAE tiling.
Cause: VAE tiling seams on some GPU/model stacks.
Do: Prefer VAE slicing if memory-constrained; keep tiling off unless proven safe for that model/GPU; A/B before enabling by default.
Don't: Leave VAE tiling on as a silent default after seeing mesh artifacts.
Pointer: local diffusion apps on consumer GPUs.

title: Prefer quantized fast weights over bf16 thrash
text:
Symptom / ask: Inference crawls (~minutes/step) on a 24GB GPU.
Cause: Full bf16 + CPU offload thrash when a fast quantized path exists.
Do: Prefer local fp8/int8 (or project 'Fast weights') after fusing LoRA; keep long runs off raw bf16+offload.
Don't: Claim a weight mode works without load-status proof; disk files ≠ successful load.
Pointer: FLUX/SDXL desktop inference.

title: Hugging Face gated models need license + token
text:
Symptom / ask: Gated model download/load fails or is 'worked around'.
Cause: Missing license accept and/or HF token; temptation to fake bypass.
Do: Accept the model license; provide a Read token via secure local store/env; keep token files out of public shares.
Don't: Invent bypasses or commit tokens to git.
Pointer: gated FLUX/SDXL/Wan bases.

title: Code checkpoints are not weight backups
text:
Symptom / ask: Restoring a 'checkpoint' wiped UI or lost LoRAs unexpectedly.
Cause: Code baseline swaps and weight/model backups are different operations.
Do: Keep separate flows: code checkpoint applies source baselines; weight backup/restore handles safetensors/LoRAs/tokens.
Don't: Treat one button as both code rollback and model vault.
Pointer: local ML desktop apps with dual backup systems.

title: Don't mix incompatible model stacks
text:
Symptom / ask: Wrong LoRA type on the wrong engine; VRAM fights between stacks.
Cause: Still and video (or SDXL vs Wan) weights loaded together or LoRAs applied across engines.
Do: Unload the other engine when switching; keep LoRA stacks engine-specific.
Don't: Put video LoRAs on a still SDXL stack or leave both full stacks resident 'just in case'.
Pointer: multi-engine local studios.

title: Moderate stacked identity controls
text:
Symptom / ask: Faces/necks melt on full-body gens despite a trained LoRA.
Cause: LoRA + high Face-lock/IP-Adapter + aggressive face refine stacked together.
Do: After a character LoRA exists, prefer LoRA/trigger identity; keep Face-lock moderate if used; unload unused IP-Adapter (scale=0 is not enough).
Don't: Default to LoRA + high Face-lock + strong face refine on full-body.
Pointer: character consistency pipelines.

title: BASE checkpoints vs LoRA files hygiene
text:
Symptom / ask: Huge bases in the LoRA folder; wrong file selected as BASE.
Cause: Folder hygiene conflates ~4GB+ checkpoints with small LoRAs.
Do: Keep full checkpoints in checkpoints/; LoRAs in loras/; select BASE explicitly; never put multi-GB bases in the LoRA list.
Don't: Treat every safetensors as interchangeable.
Pointer: Diffusers/Kohya desktop layouts.

title: Edit models need state-transition prompts
text:
Symptom / ask: Kontext/edit model ignores cleanup intent and redraws a new scene.
Cause: Prompt written like text-to-image subject description instead of an edit instruction.
Do: State the transition (photo-of-print → native digital), list artifacts to remove, and lock identity/pose/framing.
Don't: Zoom/crop instructions that fight 1:1 preservation when that is the goal.
Pointer: FLUX Kontext and similar image-edit models.
